subject.title: Feishu: read image tool result loses media before final outbound payload

question: Which existing open fix path should own the remaining shared read-image media bridge for this issue?
rationale: Current main still misses the bridge, but multiple open candidate PRs change trusted media promotion in different ways, so issue triage should not queue another branch or choose the permanent merge shape by itself.

options.title: Repair and review the current shared-media PR
options.body: Use `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442` or a narrow replacement after its lint, proof, and trusted-media review blockers are resolved.

options.title: Port the start-args fallback PR
options.body: Revive or replace `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50359` if maintainers prefer preserving the originating read path rather than persisting inline image bytes.

options.title: Pause until Feishu safety work is settled
options.body: Keep this issue open while the related Feishu fallback/security work is reviewed if maintainers want the trust-boundary decision handled first.

recommendation.title: Repair and review the current shared-media PR
recommendation.body: Use `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97442` or a narrow replacement after its lint, proof, and trusted-media review blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the shared pending tool-media reply delivery refactor that the candidate fixes must integrate with.
